authority: Disclosure of known defects in a committed release. Source: records/sprint/B-KNOWN-ISSUES-DISCLOSURE.md (sprint-ledger, from control's list). Each entry is shown to the analyst under DO NOT RELY ON in the context pack. Append an entry when a defect is found; set status to FIXED (with fixed_in) when a later release removes it; never delete an entry.

entry_shape.verification: BYTES (checked against files) | CONTROL (control's tracking, not re-verified)
entry_shape.do_not_rely: One sentence for the analyst: what not to rely on.
entry_shape.effect: What is wrong and its size.
entry_shape.affected_paths: Payload paths or surfaces the defect touches (empty if it is a wording or scope limit).

fix.ticket: issue or PR number or null

issues.do_not_rely: The Schwab coverage sentence that says 2 accepted accounts hold cash only: it counts account 691, which holds a money-market position of about 70,856 USD, and the 691 positions were never captured.
issues.effect: A wrong sentence in the downloadable payload JSON only; it is not rendered and no number, status or panel screen depends on it. The matrix cells for the two accounts say NO_ACCEPTED_FACT_PATH and name the gap.

fix.note: governed empty-position account list (054 only), a real 691 position row, new Schwab generation

issues.do_not_rely: Annualised figures on the 14 panel rows (and 62 analytics rows) that scale by 252 periods a year where 242 or 260 apply.
issues.effect: Annualised figures on those rows are slightly mis-scaled.

issues.do_not_rely: Any factor-based statistic as covering October and November 2026: factor data end on 2026-09-30.
issues.effect: Factor-based statistics do not cover Oct-Nov 2026.

issues.do_not_rely: Pre-2011 excess returns: the 2007-2010 style and sector risk-free rate is a price-return proxy (BIL), not a total-return series.
issues.effect: Excess returns before 2011 use a proxy risk-free rate.

issues.do_not_rely: The as-of date on total liquid capital: it is the oldest component's date (2025-11-24, a 0.19 USD Echotrade balance), not the cutoff.
issues.effect: The as-of label is the oldest component's date; the amounts are unaffected.

issues.do_not_rely: The wording 'no reported events' for the 558 provider transactions that have events but no strategy attribution.
issues.effect: The matrix says no events where events exist but none is attributed to a strategy.

fix.note: typed status for events not attributed (ledger bundle, PR 1003)

issues.do_not_rely: Volatis values on fill days: the fill-day restatement is not applied, so those days carry the dashboard value before the fill (for example 2025-08-06 shows 21,771.95 where the restated figure is 10,903.65).
issues.effect: Volatis fill days use the dashboard NAV, as in release A5; the fill-closes pin carries split-adjusted closes against as-traded quantities.

fix.note: as-traded closes pin, guards, deposit-day netting

issues.do_not_rely: AI Factor and EU rows as account-basis figures: they are on the model (restated to the sleeve) basis.
issues.effect: Those rows are model basis, as the AI Factor basis ruling of 2026-11-02 (B) directs.

fix.note: per the basis ruling, as queued

issues.do_not_rely: Schwab account 691 as covered for positions: its positions cell has no accepted fact path.
issues.effect: Holdings against signals for that account cannot be checked from the payload.

issues.do_not_rely: Robuxio return spans as complete: span wording and coverage are open.
issues.effect: Return-span wording and coverage for Robuxio are not closed.
